observations: A note rather than a finding, on a path neither the review nor this round's tests reach: backfillIndex writes a record for every open record with no Pending, and `open()` includes one that is in flight. When the back-fill runs (an unmarked bucket, or now a cursor an index-less build wrote) and meets a record under another process's live claim, its writeRecord moves that record's revision, so the claimant's outcome write loses its compare-and-set and logs `webhook redelivery outcome not recorded`. No delivery is lost — the entry is written and the delivery is decided again once the claim expires — but it is the same claim-stealing the live-claim branch in decide was careful to avoid, and the two paths now disagree about it. Cheap to settle either way: skip an in-flight record in the back-fill as decide does, or say in the comment why taking the claim is acceptable there.
